title: Goodwill Rate Card for Wrong Entries on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
The goodwill percent for an error-correcting change order on a Design Studio Selections file is set by where the wrong entry was made and how long it stood, counted in calendar days from the date the removed line was selected to the date of the error-correcting change order.

| Where the removed line was selected | Calendar days it stood | Goodwill percent |
|---|---|---|
| In the studio | More than 30 | 20 |
| In the studio | 30 or fewer | 10 |
| Through the buyer portal | Any | 5 |

**Records read**

- The selection channel and the selection date shown on the removed line's selection entry in the design ledger.
- The date of the error-correcting change order entry.

**Boundary cases on hypothetical dates** (line selected in the studio on 2026-01-10)

| Date of the error-correcting change order | Days stood | Goodwill percent |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-09 | 30 | 10 |
| 2026-02-10 | 31 | 20 |

A removed line selected through the buyer portal takes 5 percent whether it stood 3 days or 300.

**Basis Q&A**

*Is the age counted to today's date?* No. It runs from the selection date of the removed line to the date of the error-correcting change order.
